resources.string: Devices sold in some regions force the camera shutter sound to play even in silent mode. This app uses Shizuku to switch that enforcement (AudioSystem FOR_SYSTEM) off and back on.

The change lives in audioserver only: a reboot or an audioserver restart puts the device default back, and nothing else does. Uninstalling the app does not undo it, so restore before removing the app.

With the enforcement off, the shutter follows the ringer mode: it is silenced in silent or vibrate mode only. Other sounds that use the enforced stream are affected the same way.

Respect the privacy of the people around you and the rules where you live.
Now: not enforced (follows the ringer mode)
The device default comes back on reboot. Restore it before uninstalling.
Could not restore: Shizuku may be stopped. Start it and restore from the app, or reboot.
Already not enforced, so nothing changed. If the shutter still sounds in silent mode, the camera app plays it by itself and this app cannot stop it.
